'''2002 World Championship Top 8 Bastian Winkelhaus LS Quiet Mining Colony''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Bastian Winkelhaus]] at [[2002 World Championship]] (Top 8), finishing 8th; the list below is from the official Players Committee decklist form.<ref name="src">[http://www.theforce.net/ccg/sw/decks/bastianLS.pdf SWCCG Players Committee decklist form: Quiet Mining Colony]</ref>

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Bastian Winkelhaus]]
* '''Event:''' [[2002 World Championship]]
* '''Stage:''' Top 8
* '''Finish:''' 8th
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation|ECC-L-quietminingcolony.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Quiet Mining Colony
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]]
* '''Source:''' [http://www.theforce.net/ccg/sw/decks/bastianLS.pdf PC decklist form]
